sasha_cs: Cedarwell returned vendor security form — asked for SOC2 Type II, backup encryption algo, incident notif SLA (<48h requested), and subprocessor list. Renewal in ~6 weeks. :eyes:
onboard-bot: Form submitted: https://forms.internal/cedarwell-2026.pdf
olivia_sec: which items missing vs accepted?

miguel_eng: BYOK: supported for Private deployments only. For Hosted we offer provider KMS, envelope encryption, and audit logs; we don't accept external key imports.
chris_csm: renewal flagged medium risk if docs not back in 10 business days. Recommend evidence packet + 30m call with their security lead.
olivia_sec: I'll draft answers: attach redacted SOC2, state incident ack within 24h, impact assessment 72h, remediation plan within 10 business days.
sasha_cs: please make a one-pager and upload. I'll submit and schedule Tue 10am PST for 30m sync.
